C-008.reasoning: Markup makes the fee on Contingent Consideration payable only if, as and when it is actually paid.

C-009.reasoning: Memo identifies the 50% retainer credit as below the 100% market standard.

C-011.reasoning: Memo quantifies $450,000 of non-creditable retainer over a 12-month, $900,000 engagement.
